remarks: Completely renovated and move-in ready! This sun-filled 2-bedroom, 1.75-bath duplex has been thoughtfully remodeled from top to bottom, featuring a stunning new kitchen, beautifully updated bathrooms, newly refinished hardwood floors, fresh paint, new carpeting, and updated electrical. Offering approximately 1,200 square feet of living space, the home also includes garage parking, a private patio, and a fully fenced yard. Perfectly positioned just minutes from Greenwich Point Beach, Riverside Commons, and the Old Greenwich Metro-North station, this exceptional home is located in the sought-after Dundee Elementary School district. Enjoy turnkey living in one of Riverside's most desirable neighborhoods.
